name: Maelstrom
chapters: Watson: Northside Industrial District (Totentanz, All Foods). The Pickup.
weak: Mostly Tier 1–2 (the Fiend is Tier 3). Ironstormer and Techie have Medium Subdermal Armor. Their robots (Tier 1 androids) take extra Short Circuit damage
tactic: Chrome fetishists with faceplates and red optics. Nearly every unit has Smokey Eye and many carry Thermal Mods (burning hits), frag grenades and Charge Jump. Codefreak netrunners Overheat you: find them and drop them first. Fiends and Zealots are Sandevistan fast-melee: Cyberware Malfunction stops them.
note: Second Conflict (Kerry) also pits you against them, but the guide has no page for that job.

name: Tyger Claws
chapters: Westbrook: Japantown and Charter Hill; Watson: Little China and Kabuki. Automatic Love.
weak: Tiers 1–3. The heavies (Claw, Fang, Ozeki) carry Medium or Heavy Subdermal Armor and Masking Ink
tactic: Organised and fast: katana fast-melee (Adept and Kunoichi, with Sandevistan and Kerenzikov), shotgunners and Dragons. Many carry Electrical Mods and EMP grenades, so expect shock and EMP. Jonin netrunners use Overheat and Weapon Malfunction. Lots of bikes. Keep moving against the blades and use Cyberware Malfunction.

name: Valentinos
chapters: Heywood: The Glen, Vista del Rey and Wellsprings. Heroes.
weak: Tiers 1–3. The Toro has Heavy Subdermal Armor
tactic: Gold chrome and Santa Muerte. Thermal Mods are common (Gangoon, Sanguinario with incendiary grenades, Macho, Francotirador, Sicario). The Tier 3 Francotirador is a fast sniper with Sandevistan; Macho and Sicario are fast shotgunners with Sandevistan Mk.2. They are neutral to strangers who do not cause trouble.

name: 6th Street
chapters: Santo Domingo (Arroyo HQ and most of the district); garages elsewhere. Black Steel In The Hour of Chaos (allies, with Will Gunner) and Beat on the Brat in Arroyo.
weak: Tiers 1–3 with few cyber abilities. The Robot and the Corporal have Medium Subdermal Armor
tactic: Veterans and ex-cops playing militia: disciplined ranged fighters, shotgun Sarges and Lieutenants (the Tier 3 Lieutenant is a fast shotgunner with Sandevistan Mk.2), snipers and robots. Their soldier tactics work best at range: close in or out-flank them.

name: Animals
chapters: No turf: west Pacifica (Grand Imperial Mall); bouncers and bodyguards citywide. I Walk the Line, Beat on the Brat (Rhino, Razor Hugh) and I Fought the Law.
weak: Heavy-melee bias: Thickskull and Wrecker (Tier 3) have Heavy Subdermal Armor; Undertaker and Crusher have Medium
tactic: Juice-fuelled brawlers who eschew traditional cyberware. The heavy units have Break Hold (cannot be grabbed), Charge Jump and Sandevistan; they use flashbangs and Combat Stim. Do not trade blows: kite and shoot, shotgun them at the end of a charge and use Cripple Movement. A pack alpha leads each group.

name: Voodoo Boys
chapters: Pacifica: Coastview (Batty's Hotel, the church); Dogtown branch (Luxor High Wellness Spa). M'ap Tann Pèlen, I Walk the Line, Transmission and the Phantom Liberty gig Treating Symptoms.
weak: All Tier 2–3, with many netrunners
tactic: Netrunners obsessed with the Old Net (Tier 2 Netrunner, Tier 3 Manbo with Sandevistan). They Overheat you from cover, and Malfini and Punisher throw EMP grenades. Bring Self-ICE, break line of sight and hunt the netrunners first. The Dogtown branch works with BARGHEST and guards Hansen's data.
note: Their fate depends on I Walk the Line and Transmission: on the NetWatch branch they are wiped out; otherwise they cross the Blackwall.

name: The Mox
chapters: Watson: Kabuki (Lizzie's Bar). Judy's jobs and Automatic Love.
weak: No documented enemy roster
tactic: The youngest gang (2067): sex workers, punks and outcasts. Rarely hostile: they are Judy's people. Treat them as a friendly faction.

name: Scavengers
chapters: Citywide, mostly north Pacifica and south Wellsprings; better funded in Dogtown (Phantom Liberty). The Rescue and the gigs Spy in the Jungle and The Man Who Killed Jason Foreman.
weak: Mostly Tier 1–2 (the Hyena is Tier 3). Cur and Vulture have Medium Subdermal Armor
tactic: Organ-legging implant thieves. Frag grenades everywhere; Rats, Crows and Hounds carry Chemical Mods (poison); Spider netrunners use Overheat; Hyena and Jackal are Sandevistan fast-melee. The Dogtown scavs are an oligarchy reportedly linked to Soviet intelligence.

name: Wraiths
chapters: The Badlands. Ghost Town, Life During Wartime and Riders on the Storm.
weak: Tiers 1–3. The Goliath has Heavy Subdermal Armor
tactic: Nomads expelled from their clans. Almost every unit throws biohazard grenades and many carry Chemical Mods (poison). Bane and Revenant have Sandevistan; Ghouls are fast ranged. In the Badlands they fight from vehicles (the armed Quartz "Specter"). Carry poison cleansing or resistance.

name: Raffen Shiv
chapters: The Badlands. Ghost Town.
weak: Same as the Wraiths
tactic: The umbrella term for nomads expelled from their clans; in-game their Night City gang is the Wraiths. Fight them the same way.

name: Aldecaldos
chapters: The Badlands (mobile camp in Rocky Ridge). Ghost Town and Panam's jobs.
weak: Not usual enemies
tactic: Panam's nomad family: usually allies. Their armed cars are the base-game armed Autofixer models.

name: BARGHEST
chapters: Pacifica: Dogtown (Black Sapphire, the stadium). The Phantom Liberty main jobs from Dog Eat Dog on, above all Spider and the Fly and Firestarter.
weak: Tier 1–3 military. Warrior and Gunner have Heavy Subdermal Armor. They field mechs, Centaur exosuits (Tier 3, with Sandevistan) and Wyvern and Bombus drones
tactic: Hansen's private army. Flashbangs on almost every unit; Assassins are fast melee with Kerenzikov, Commandos have Sandevistan, plus snipers and netrunners (Overheat, Weapon Malfunction, Electrical Mods), mechs and drones. Short Circuit and EMP on the machines, take out netrunners and snipers early, and use armor penetration on the heavies.

name: Arasaka
chapters: City Center / Corpo Plaza (Arasaka Tower); Watson / Arasaka Waterfront (Konpeki Plaza); Arasaka Industrial Park and Arasaka Estate. The Heist, Play It Safe, Search and Destroy and the Tower endings.
weak: Tier 2–3 elites. The Juggernaut (Mk.31 HMG) has Heavy Subdermal Armor; Bodyguard and Armored Enforcer have Medium
tactic: Corporate security of every kind: Agents and Executioners (Sandevistan Mk.2, Kerenzikov), Assassins (katana, Sandevistan), Tier 3 snipers with Sandevistan, netrunners (Overheat, Electrical Mods), robots, Minotaur mechs and turrets. Flashbangs are universal. Netrunners and snipers first; EMP and Short Circuit on machines; pick up the Juggernaut's HMG.

name: Militech
chapters: No turf: convoys and their own sites; in Phantom Liberty, on Myers's and the NUSA's side. The Pickup, Spider and the Fly (the Chimera) and Somewhat Damaged (Cerberus).
weak: Tiers 1–3. The Heavy Gunner has Heavy Subdermal Armor and the Field Engineer Medium. They bring Minotaur mechs, Griffin and Wyvern drones and Aegis X2 turrets
tactic: Professional soldiers with flashbangs, shotgunners, Tier 3 Commandos with Sandevistan and snipers. They bring mechs to fights: in The Pickup they deploy two Minotaurs if you side with Maelstrom (EMP grenades; hack them).

name: NCPD
chapters: Citywide except the Badlands; rarely in the Northside Industrial District and Pacifica. The NCPD Scanner Hustles.
weak: Tier 1 Beat Cops up to Tier 3 Corporals. Tactical Officers (M2067 Defender) have Medium Subdermal Armor; there are robots and a Minotaur variant
tactic: The 2.0 wanted system: crimes start chases on foot and by car; more stars bring armored units and roadblocks, and 5 stars bring MaxTac AVs. You can now quickhack officers. To escape, get out of sight; a CrystalCoat repaint (2.2) lowers your wanted level.

name: MaxTac
chapters: Citywide at 5 wanted stars; the Black Steel In The Hour of Chaos convoy (Phantom Liberty).
weak: Squads with roles: Assault (Ajax, Defender), Mantis (MaxTac Mantis Blades, Omaha), Heavy (exosuit, Defender), Netrunner and Sniper (Ashura, Sandevistan). Subdermal Armor, Sandevistan Mk.3 and Kerenzikov
tactic: They can kill V in a few shots on high difficulty at any level. Kill or lock down the netrunner first (slow uploads, huge damage), keep the Mantis officer at range and break line of sight to drop the wanted level. Cyberware Malfunction against their Sandevistan.

name: Kang Tao
chapters: No turf: the Hellman AV crash and the Badlands gas station. Lightning Breaks and Life During Wartime.
weak: Their robots are weak to electrical damage (game8): Short Circuit and EMP
tactic: A Chinese weapons corp with smart guns and robot guards. The gas station is mined. There is no unit list on the wiki.

name: Biotechnica (security)
chapters: The Badlands (Biotechnica Flats), in gigs.
weak: Uses Robot R Mk.2 units: Short Circuit and EMP
tactic: Corporate security met in gigs. The wiki has no unit list, so it is unverified as a distinct enemy faction.

name: NetWatch
chapters: No turf: the Grand Imperial Mall operation (Pacifica) and later ambushes in Phantom Liberty. I Walk the Line, Transmission and, after This Corrosion, Somewhat Damaged or Leave in Silence.
weak: Netrunner agents
tactic: The net police, hunting the Voodoo Boys. In I Walk the Line it is Bryce Mosley's operation, with the Animals as hired guns. In Phantom Liberty its agents ambush V after This Corrosion (Erebus or Canto). Bring Self-ICE and break line of sight.

name: NUSA Black Ops (FIA)
chapters: Phantom Liberty: Morro Rock (NCX Spaceport) and Dogtown missions. The Killing Moon.
weak: Tiers 2–3. The HMG Operative has Heavy Subdermal Armor. They field a mech (Minotaur variant) and a drone (Wyvern variant)
tactic: Myers's forces: flashbang operatives, Tier 3 fast-ranged units with Sandevistan, elite shotgunners, snipers, netrunners (Overheat, Weapon Malfunction), mechs and drones.

name: Trauma Team
chapters: Citywide, wherever a client is down.
weak: Tier 2 units; the Octant drone has Medium Subdermal Armor
tactic: Elite paramedics with heavy escorts: Assault Specialist (Sandevistan Mk.2 shotgunner), Support (frag grenades), Medic and the Octant drone. They only fight if you attack them or their client.

name: Enemy netrunner
chapters: Maelstrom Codefreak, Tyger Claws Jonin, Voodoo Boys Netrunner and Manbo, Scavenger Spider, Arasaka, BARGHEST, NUSA Black Ops, NCPD and MaxTac.
weak: Fragile once found; usually stays behind cover
tactic: Uploads Overheat, Weapon Malfunction and similar on V; a trace bar runs while you are being hacked. Answers: **Self-ICE** negates one hack; break line of sight; go for them first; the Counter-A-Hack perk (through walls); System Collapse knocks them out silently; the Arasaka cyberdeck slows traces. Their AI improved in 2.0.

name: Sniper
chapters: Most factions: Maelstrom Raven, Valentinos Francotirador, Arasaka, BARGHEST, NUSA Black Ops, Militech, Scavengers, 6th Street and Wraiths. Play It Safe has two.
weak: The Tier 3 "fast" variants (Francotirador, the Arasaka sniper) use Sandevistan
tactic: A visible laser telegraphs the shot. Break line of sight, flank, or blind them with quickhacks (Reboot Optics). In open areas, kill them early.

name: Heavy gunner
chapters: Arasaka Juggernaut, Maelstrom Ironstormer, Animals Crusher and Wrecker, Wraiths Goliath, BARGHEST Gunner, Militech Heavy Gunner, NUSA HMG Operative and NCPD Tactical Officer.
weak: Medium or Heavy Subdermal Armor: use armor-piercing weapons, quickhacks and explosives
tactic: Slow, with HMG or Defender suppression. Fight from hard cover and flank. Many carry an Mk.31 HMG you can pick up.

name: Heavy melee
chapters: Animals Thickskull and Undertaker, Valentinos Toro and Matón, Tyger Claws Ozeki, Claw and Fang, BARGHEST Warrior, Scavenger Cur, Wraiths Skewer and Arasaka Bodyguard.
weak: Heavy Subdermal Armor; Break Hold (cannot be grabbed); Charge Jump
tactic: Do not melee them head-on: backpedal and shoot, punish after their slam and use Cripple Movement.

name: Fast melee / Sandevistan user
chapters: Maelstrom Fiend and Zealot, Tyger Claws Adept and Kunoichi, Valentinos Guerrero, Voodoo Boys Spirit, Scavenger Hyena and Jackal, Wraiths Revenant, Arasaka Assassin and Special Agent, BARGHEST Assassin and 6th Street Soldier (Fast Melee).
weak: **Cyberware Malfunction** shuts off their Sandevistan and Kerenzikov (at Tier 3, two stacks disable it for good)
tactic: Since 2.0 they counter-activate their Sandevistan when you use yours. Dodge their opener, then shotgun or blunt-weapon them. Kerenzikov users dodge mid-air.

name: Shotgunner / fast shotgunner
chapters: Every faction: Tyger Claws Blitzer, Valentinos Macho and Sicario, Voodoo Boys Punisher, Wraiths Bane, 6th Street Lieutenant, Arasaka Tactician, MaxTac Enforcer and Officer.
weak: Lethal only up close
tactic: Hold mid range. The "fast" variants close in with Sandevistan Mk.2 and Kerenzikov: Cyberware Malfunction stops them.

name: Mech (Militech Minotaur and variants)
chapters: Militech, Arasaka (own variant), NCPD (twin Smart Mk.31 HMG variant), BARGHEST (Black Sapphire) and NUSA (NCX Spaceport). The Pickup and The Heist.
weak: A machine: Short Circuit deals extra damage, EMP affects it and it cannot be knocked out
tactic: A two-legged, remote-controlled robot carrying a Smart Mk.31 HMG. Hack it: **Cyberpsychosis** turns a Minotaur friendly. EMP grenades and shots at the exposed parts. An optional mini-boss in The Heist; two appear in The Pickup.

name: Combat drone (Griffin, Wyvern, Bombus, Octant)
chapters: Militech, BARGHEST (Wyvern and Bombus variants), NUSA (Wyvern variant), Trauma Team (Octant) and Boris Ribakov's fight in Gig: Spy in the Jungle.
weak: A machine: Short Circuit bonus damage and EMP; Contagion is ineffective against drones and mechs
tactic: Shoot them down fast, or hack the netrunner or controller. The Zetatech Bombus is the small, basketball-sized drone.

name: Security turret (Militech Aegis X2 / Arasaka David IIIC)
chapters: Corporate sites, Russel Greene's homestead, Ben DeBaillon's garage and Tamara Cosby's camp. The Information has a David IIIC.
weak: A netrunner can make it inert or friendly; Technical Ability overrides it; Body rips off its HMG
tactic: Hack it, or its camera network, before going loud. Short Circuit deals bonus damage. A ripped-off Mk.31 HMG can be carried.

name: Android / Robot R Mk.2
chapters: Maelstrom Robot (Tier 1), 6th Street Robot (Medium Subdermal Armor), NCPD and Arasaka robots; also used by Militech, Kang Tao and Biotechnica. Lightning Breaks, with Kang Tao's robots.
weak: A machine: Short Circuit bonus damage, EMP, and it can only be destroyed
tactic: A humanoid defense robot "for those who do not wish to use live assets". Treat it as a ranged grunt that never panics.

name: Militech Centaur exosuit
chapters: Royce, Chase Coley, Euralio Alma, the BARGHEST Centaur (Tier 3, with Sandevistan) and MaxTac. The Pickup.
weak: The **spine power unit**: it overheats after several shots and leaves the pilot helpless. Shoot or grenade it
tactic: A shield on the left arm covers the pilot and a thermal heat-wave weapon sits on the right. Slow and not agile: circle behind it.

name: Militech heavy robots (Chimera, Cerberus)
chapters: Phantom Liberty only: Dogtown (BARGHEST had at least two Chimeras) and Cynosure. Spider and the Fly and Somewhat Damaged.
weak: Chimera: weak spots and attacks from above. Cerberus: invulnerable
tactic: Boss-only hexapods, not regular enemies. See their boss entries.

name: Cyberpsycho
chapters: The 17 Cyberpsycho Sightings, in every district except Westbrook and Dogtown.
weak: Each one differs: see their entry
tactic: Boss-tier humans with stacked cyberware. Keeping them alive is optional: blunt weapons, the Pax mod or System Collapse.
note: Regina Jones's Psycho Killer job tracks them; completing them all earns the I Am The Law achievement.

name: Cyberjunkie
chapters: Dogtown (Phantom Liberty), from Lucretia My Reflection.
weak: Each one differs: see their boss entry
tactic: Drug-driven cyberpsychos: 11 in Dogtown. No fixer, no reward for sparing them and no achievement; they drop loot and a shard.

name: Matt Liaw
chapters: Watson / Kabuki: the unfinished highway bridge south of the All Foods Plant. Opens after The Pickup · Cyberpsycho Sighting: Demons of War
weak: Exposed when he moves between hiding spots
tactic: An ex-Militech solo with a rifle: he shoots, runs to the next hiding spot and lobs incendiary grenades. He has Sandevistan, Charge Jump and flashbangs. Take cover from his sniping and close the gap while he moves. Afterwards, the laptop is in a storage crate.
note: Regina's reward: €$2,550, 293 Street Cred and 300 XP. Can be taken alive (blunt weapons, the Pax mod or System Collapse); not required: Regina pays even if you kill them.

name: Lt. Mower
chapters: Watson / Kabuki: the flooded square at Allen St & Abraham St · Cyberpsycho Sighting: Lt. Mower
weak: The **generators** on both sides of the arena electrify the water: disable them with Technical Ability or destroy them
tactic: A Ghost in the Shell homage. Entering the arena locks you into combat and leaving resets the fight; grenades thrown into the water do not work. Abilities: optical camo, Sandevistan Mk.1, Kerenzikov, Gorilla Arms, Break Hold and frag grenades. Kill the power first, then track her through the camo; avoid melee.
drops: Electric Baton Alpha and the PSYCHO racerback tank.
note: Regina's reward: €$2,550, 293 Street Cred and 300 XP. Can be taken alive (blunt weapons, the Pax mod or System Collapse); not required: Regina pays even if you kill them.

name: Alec Johnson
chapters: Watson / Little China: the Bodyweight Warehouse, at the docks · Cyberpsycho Sighting: Ticket to the Major Leagues
weak: Heavy Subdermal Armor: armor-piercing weapons and quickhacks
tactic: An Afterlife merc gone psycho on drugs. If he spots you he runs to the AV landing pad and pulls out an M2067 Defender: reach him fast or fight from behind the crates. He has Break Hold, Charge Jump and grenades of every type (a bug). He carries the shard "Glitter".
note: Regina's reward: €$2,300, 369 Street Cred and 300 XP. Can be taken alive, and Regina praises you for it; not required.

name: Ellis Carter
chapters: Watson / Northside: behind Totentanz · Cyberpsycho Sighting: Where the Bodies Hit the Floor
weak: One of the easiest: a stealth takedown or Cripple Movement, then sustained damage
tactic: A Maelstromer loyal to Brick who went psycho trying to take on Royce. He attacks on sight. He has Sandevistan Mk.1, Kerenzikov, Break Hold, frag grenades and Smokey Eye; Cyberware Malfunction shuts off his Sandevistan.
note: Regina's reward: €$2,900, 344 Street Cred and 300 XP. Can be taken alive; Regina judges him too far gone, a "test subject". Not required.

name: Lely Hein
chapters: Watson / Northside: the abandoned train station south-east of Ebunike Docks · Cyberpsycho Sighting: Six Feet Under
weak: Fights from cover: punish him when he breaks it
tactic: A Valentino forcibly chromed by Maelstrom, executing Maelstromers by the servers. He carries a DB-4 Igla shotgun (sources disagree: epicdope calls him a sniper), frag grenades, Combat Stim, Smokey Eye and Thermal Mods. Keep mid range and shoot when he breaks cover. His shard "Farewell" links him to Tamara Cosby.
note: Regina's reward: €$2,900, 344 Street Cred and 300 XP. Can be taken alive (blunt weapons, the Pax mod or System Collapse); not required: Regina pays even if you kill them.

name: Zaria Hughes
chapters: Watson / Northside. Opens after Playing for Time, only from 8 PM to 5 AM · Cyberpsycho Sighting: Bloody Ritual
weak: Cyberware Malfunction shuts off her Sandevistan and Kerenzikov
tactic: A Maelstrom cult ritual: question the dying cultist, crack the shard and she bursts out of a fridge. She is extremely fast, with Mantis Blades, optical camo, Sandevistan Mk.1, Kerenzikov and Smokey Eye. Dodge her rushes and burst her with a shotgun or LMG when she closes in (epicdope suggests the Defender).
note: Regina's reward: €$2,900, 344 Street Cred and 300 XP. Can be taken alive (blunt weapons, the Pax mod or System Collapse); not required: Regina pays even if you kill them.

name: Diego Ramirez
chapters: Pacifica / Coastview: the end of Pacifica Pier · Cyberpsycho Sighting: Smoke on the Water
weak: Bring his daughter Sofia's body (in a van under the pier) near him and he is briefly stunned
tactic: An ex-special-forces soldier hunting the Tyger Claws who killed his daughter. M2038 Tactician shotgun (one-shot danger), Sandevistan Mk.2, Kerenzikov and flashbangs. Keep your distance, lock him down with quickhacks and use ranged weapons. Leave afterwards: MaxTac is on the way and the crime-scene cops never despawn.
note: Regina's reward: €$5,400, 650 Street Cred and 300 XP. Can be taken alive, and Regina is happy if he lives; not required.

name: Ben DeBaillon
chapters: Pacifica / Coastview: the garage on the pier by the Grand Imperial Mall underpass · Cyberpsycho Sighting: Lex Talionis
weak: Weak on his own: he relies on automated security (cameras, turrets, drones)
tactic: A Voodoo Boys netrunner ("SpaceBoy_66") who went psycho after NetWatch caught him. He Overheats you. Take out the cameras first (shoot or hack them), then the drones and turrets (grenades, Short Circuit), and he is helpless.
note: Regina's reward: €$5,400, 650 Street Cred and 300 XP. Can be taken alive, but drones exploding near his unconscious body can kill him: clear them first. Not required.

name: Chase Coley
chapters: Santo Domingo / Rancho Coronado: the construction site · Cyberpsycho Sighting: Discount Doc
weak: Militech Centaur exosuit: the **spine-mounted power unit** overheats after several shots and leaves the pilot vulnerable
tactic: A construction worker given military implants and a Centaur by his boss. A ballistic shield on the left arm and a heat-wave weapon on the right. Get above or behind him and grenade the power unit; once the suit is down he is slow and easy.
note: Regina's reward: €$5,800, 650 Street Cred and 300 XP. Can be taken alive (blunt weapons, the Pax mod or System Collapse); not required: Regina pays even if you kill them.

name: Tamara Cosby
chapters: Santo Domingo / Arroyo: the homeless camp under the highway bridge · Cyberpsycho Sighting: Under the Bridge
weak: A netrunner: low physical threat
tactic: A Valentino netrunner (Lely Hein's girlfriend) who slaughtered the camp. She quickhacks you and throws EMP grenades. Set the camp's two turrets to friendly first, then gun her down; Self-ICE blunts her hacks.
note: Regina's reward: €$6,650, 650 Street Cred and 300 XP. Can be taken alive (blunt weapons, the Pax mod or System Collapse); not required: Regina pays even if you kill them.

name: Russel Greene
chapters: Badlands / Rocky Ridge: the Greene Homestead · Cyberpsycho Sighting: House on a Hill
weak: His defense is turrets and mines: disable them first and he loses his edge
tactic: A paranoid homesteader with turrets around the house and mines in the yard: clear or avoid them before you engage. DB-2 Satara shotgun, Sandevistan, Kerenzikov and frag grenades. Dodge his shotgun and fight at range.
note: Regina's reward: €$5,400, 650 Street Cred and 300 XP. Can be taken alive (blunt weapons, the Pax mod or System Collapse); not required: Regina pays even if you kill them.

name: Zion Wylde
chapters: Badlands / Vasquez Pass: the trailer camp around a wind turbine · Cyberpsycho Sighting: Second Chances
weak: From range: a sniper rifle or System Collapse
tactic: A Unification War veteran "sacrificing" Wraiths to the Loa (a Voodoo Boys hack). He spots you from far away and the camp is mined. Approach in cover. He carries a SOR-22 and DR-5 Nova and Sandevistan Mk.2.
note: Regina's reward: €$5,400, 650 Street Cred and 300 XP. The objective says "kill or incapacitate": your choice. Regina pays either way.

name: Euralio Alma
chapters: Badlands / Rocky Ridge. Opens after Life During Wartime · Cyberpsycho Sighting: The Wasteland
weak: Militech Centaur exosuit: the same power unit; Short Circuit also helps
tactic: An Aldecaldo held by the same Wraiths who took Saul. Sneak up, grenade the suit's power unit and use the explosives around when he charges.
note: Regina's reward: €$5,400, 1,949 Street Cred and 300 XP. He dies of his injuries even if incapacitated; he is buried at the Aldecaldo camp graveyard.

name: Gaston Phillips
chapters: Heywood / Wellsprings: the fenced courtyard and garage · Cyberpsycho Sighting: Letter of the Law
weak: His garage is mined and has laser tripwires: disable them and he is exposed
tactic: A man whose home was repossessed by Zetatech. Disable the mines and laser tripwires before fighting. He carries an M251s Ajax, frag grenades and Sandevistan.
note: Regina's reward: €$7,950, 650 Street Cred and 300 XP. Can be taken alive (blunt weapons, the Pax mod or System Collapse); not required: Regina pays even if you kill them.

name: Dao Hyunh
chapters: Heywood / Wellsprings: the beach café. Opens after The Heist · Cyberpsycho Sighting: Seaside Cafe
weak: From range and unseen: a sniper rifle or System Collapse
tactic: An actress who snapped while filming "Saigon Sisters". Overture revolver, Sandevistan and incendiary grenades. Stay unseen and open from range; avoid melee and grenades.
note: Regina's reward: €$7,950, 650 Street Cred and 300 XP. Can be taken alive (blunt weapons, the Pax mod or System Collapse); not required: Regina pays even if you kill them.

name: Cedric Muller
chapters: City Center / Downtown: the parking lot by the Downtown Central fast travel point · Cyberpsycho Sighting: On Deaf Ears
weak: Range and cover, or System Collapse
tactic: A Red Ocher nomad, a survivor of Biotechnica's Project Nightingale, betrayed by scavs. Carnage shotgun and Sandevistan Mk.2. Do not melee him.
note: Regina's reward: €$7,770, 650 Street Cred and 300 XP. Can be taken alive, and Regina hopes he rejoins his clan; not required.

name: Norio Akuhara
chapters: City Center / Corpo Plaza: the renovation corridor · Cyberpsycho Sighting: Phantom of Night City
weak: The danger is the Tyger Claws ambush, not him
tactic: An ex-Tyger Claw, "Akki", killing the Claws who murdered Julia. He warns V off and tries to flee, then a Tyger Claws ambush hits him at the exit. Clear the Claws while protecting him. He has optical camo, Masking Ink, Sandevistan Mk.1, EMP grenades and a katana.
note: Regina's reward: €$7,770, 650 Street Cred and 300 XP. Can be taken alive, but if the Claws hurt him too much it is no longer possible: kill them fast. Not required.
